purpose: 题面复现（解析器层）：对每个可用的请求解析器（py；C 扩展可用时再加 c）喂 6 个原始请求，逐行打印 OK/FAIL。输出一律经 ascii() 转义，避免终端编码影响退出码。修复前预计：py 行的 new_hdr_name_nonascii 打印 parsed [('POST', '/', [('\xffoo', 'bar')])]（即字段名 ÿoo 被接受），new_reqline_lf_ff 打印 parsed [('GET', '/path', [])]，两行都是 FAIL；issue_ex1_literal 是题面例 1 的字面写法（bytes 塞进 f-string），修复前就已经是 OK（抛 InvalidHeader，因为字段名里有字面反斜杠）；三行 keep_* 为 OK；最后打印 FAILS 2，退出码 1。如果有 c 行，预计全部 OK（未验证）。修复后预计全部 OK，FAILS 0，退出码 0；若修复后只剩 c 行 FAIL，说明已编译的 C 扩展本身不拒绝这些输入，需要单独记录。
cmd:
cd /testbed && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python - <<'EOF'
import asyncio
import sys
from unittest import mock

import aiohttp
import aiohttp.http_parser as hp
from aiohttp import http_exceptions as he

parsers = [("py", hp.HttpRequestParserPy)]
if hasattr(hp, "HttpRequestParserC"):
    parsers.append(("c", hp.HttpRequestParserC))

literal = "\xffoo: bar".encode()  # issue example 1 taken literally: bytes inside an f-string
cases = [  # (name, raw request, expected exception class; None = must parse)
    ("new_hdr_name_nonascii", "POST / HTTP/1.1\r\n\xffoo: bar\r\n\r\n".encode(), he.BadHttpMessage),
    ("issue_ex1_literal", f"POST / HTTP/1.1\r\n{literal}\r\n\r\n".encode(), he.BadHttpMessage),
    ("new_reqline_lf_ff", b"GET\n/path\x0cHTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", he.BadStatusLine),
    ("keep_plain_get", b"GET /path HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", None),
    ("keep_utf8_hdr_value", "GET /path HTTP/1.1\r\nx-test:\u0442\u0435\u0441\u0442\r\n\r\n".encode(), None),
    ("keep_nonascii_uri", b"GET \xff HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", he.InvalidURLError),
]

loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
fails = 0
print("aiohttp", aiohttp.__version__, "parsers:", [n for n, _ in parsers])
for pname, cls in parsers:
    for cname, data, exp in cases:
        p = cls(mock.Mock(), loop, 2**16, max_line_size=8190, max_headers=32768, max_field_size=8190)
        try:
            msgs = p.feed_data(data)[0]
            got = "parsed " + ascii([(m.method, m.path, list(m.headers.items())) for m, _ in msgs])
            ok = exp is None and len(msgs) == 1
        except Exception as e:
            got = ascii(e)[:160]
            ok = exp is not None and isinstance(e, exp)
        fails += not ok
        print("OK  " if ok else "FAIL", pname, cname, data, "->", got)
loop.close()
print("FAILS", fails)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
EOF

purpose: 公开 API 复现（aiohttp.web 服务端）：设 AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS=1，让服务器使用纯 Python 请求解析器（首行会打印 aiohttp.http_parser.HttpRequestParser），在 127.0.0.1 的随机端口启动应用，发送题面的两种原始请求并读取状态行。修复前预计两行都是 FAIL ... -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK，退出码 1。修复后预计两行都是 OK ... -> HTTP/1.0 400 Bad Request（错误响应沿用 HTTP/1.0 的占位消息），退出码 0；stderr 出现 'Error handling request' 日志属于正常。若打印 SETUP_ERROR 且退出码为 3，说明环境不能监听本地端口，与题目无关。
cmd:
cd /testbed && AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python - <<'EOF'
import asyncio
import sys

import aiohttp.http
from aiohttp import web

CASES = [
    ("hdr_name_nonascii", "POST / HTTP/1.1\r\n\xffoo: bar\r\n\r\n".encode()),
    ("reqline_lf_ff", b"GET\n/path\x0cHTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n"),
]


async def handler(request):
    return web.Response(text="handled")


async def main():
    cls = aiohttp.http.HttpRequestParser
    print("server request parser:", cls.__module__ + "." + cls.__name__)
    app = web.Application()
    app.router.add_route("*", "/{tail:.*}", handler)
    runner = web.AppRunner(app, access_log=None)
    await runner.setup()
    try:
        site = web.TCPSite(runner, "127.0.0.1", 0, shutdown_timeout=1)
        await site.start()
    except OSError as e:
        print("SETUP_ERROR: cannot listen on 127.0.0.1:", repr(e))
        await runner.cleanup()
        return -1
    host, port = runner.addresses[0][:2]
    bad = 0
    for name, data in CASES:
        reader, writer = await asyncio.open_connection(host, port)
        writer.write(data)
        await writer.drain()
        try:
            line = await asyncio.wait_for(reader.readline(), 10)
            status = line.decode("latin-1").strip() or "EMPTY"
        except (asyncio.TimeoutError, ConnectionError) as e:
            status = "NO_STATUS " + repr(e)
        writer.close()
        parts = status.split()
        ok = len(parts) >= 2 and parts[1] == "400"
        bad += not ok
        print("OK  " if ok else "FAIL", name, data, "->", status)
    await runner.cleanup()
    return bad


rc = asyncio.run(main())
sys.exit(3 if rc < 0 else (1 if rc else 0))
EOF
